subject: SparkBridge integrator immersion — draft agenda and logistics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sparkbridge.com>, Theo Martin <theo.m@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkBridge integrator immersion — draft agenda and logistics

Hi Elena / Theo —

Thanks again for agreeing to run a joint immersion for your SI partners. We put together a short proposal for a two-day hands-on immersion that pairs your architects with our solutions consultants. Goal is to equip integrators to: deploy a Redwood inference proof-of-concept, validate latency/cost tradeoffs, and run a simple integration test with their client stack.

High-level proposal (two-day, on-site or hybrid):
- Day 1: Architecture, serving runtime deep-dive, and deployment patterns (AM)
- Day 1: Guided hands-on: deploy sample app + baseline perf tests (PM)
- Day 2: Customization, model selection & quantization cookbooks, and partner-led lab (AM)
- Day 2: Joint validation, handoff checklist, and next steps (PM)

Logistics/questions:
1) Audience size — how many SI engineers per cohort?
2) Preferred dates / time zone constraints?
3) Any compliance/regulatory items we should pre-prepare (SOC2 excerpts, networking diagrams)?

I attached a first-pass agenda and a short slide pack we can tailor. If this looks good I’ll coordinate a calendar invite and invite the right Redwood SMEs.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: immersion-agenda-v1.pdf (1.2 MB), solutions-demo-slides.pptx (3.4 MB)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@sparkbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Theo Martin <theo.m@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:50:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SparkBridge integrator immersion — draft agenda and logistics

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the clear proposal. This looks aligned with what our SI manager asked for. Quick answers to your questions: 
- Audience: 8–10 engineers for the first cohort (mix of infra and app dev).
- Dates: we prefer late September / early October — runs best for EU teams if we do UTC mornings.
- Compliance: please include the SOC2 summary and the network diagram; our procurement team will want those ahead of the session.

One ask: can we add a short module (30–45m) on integration patterns with third-party identity providers (we have several clients using Okta/Azure AD)?

If you can confirm availability and update the agenda we’ll circulate to the SI leads.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships | SparkBridge
elena.rossi@sparkbridge.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge integrator immersion — draft agenda and logistics

Jordan / Ben —

Draft updated agenda attached (immersion-agenda-v1.pdf updated with IdP module). Notes below: 
- We’ll split Day 1 hands-on into two stations so infra and app devs can follow parallel labs (helps with cohort size).
- Speakers: Jordan (program intro + rollouts), Ben (serving runtime deep-dive + perf lab), Marissa (day 2 labs + handoff checklist).
- Pre-reads: SOC2 summary + network diagram — attached to the shared Drive link in the invite.

Action items: 
1) Jordan: confirm 2x 3-hour morning slots in UTC for late Sep — propose Sep 28–29 or Oct 5–6.
2) Ben: refine the perf lab script so it completes in 90 mins with our sample dataset.
3) Marissa: draft the partner handoff checklist and templated rollup doc for the SI (I’ll start a Confluence page).

I also added a short slide set (solutions-demo-slides.pptx) with the lab steps — Ben, please validate the timings.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partner Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: immersion-agenda-v1.pdf (updated), solutions-demo-slides.pptx

Hi Elena / Theo —

Thanks — attached is the updated agenda with the IdP module and station split. Proposed cohort dates: Sep 28–29 (UTC mornings). Please confirm which you prefer.

Next steps: 
- If dates work, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read pack (SOC2 summary + network diagram).
- Please share SI lead names and email addresses so we can do a short pre-immersion survey (skill levels, priorities).

Quick logistics + links: 
- Calendar (proposed): https://calendly.com/jordan-blake/si-immersion
- Materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSparkBridge-Immersion

Looking forward to it.

Best regards,
Jordan
